g.text: All training seeds in two frozen validation studies

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5967

g.text: Exploratory synthetic results · validation, not an independent test · no clinical validity claim

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Small symbols show every training seed (or matched control cohort), n = 30 patients each. Thin bars: per-run 95% Wilson intervals for rates; patient-bootstrap intervals for return.
Black diamonds: means of five seeds. Thick return bars: recorded 95% hierarchical bootstrap intervals, resampling seed then patient (2,000 replicates).

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5967

g.text: Controls are counted once per study. Studies use different patient cohorts; do not pair or pool across studies. Zero observed severe injury does not establish safety.
